teaching_moves.text: decommissioning begins when the team decides it is finished. *Warning sign:* your specification's first step contains a verb that only your team can perform.
teaching_moves.day_title: S074 · Estate Hygiene, Triggered by a Register

teaching_moves.label: The environment that outlives its project
teaching_moves.text: kept because the next piece of work starts soon and re-creating it is tedious. *Warning sign:* somebody says it would be a waste to tear it down.
teaching_moves.day_title: S074 · Estate Hygiene, Triggered by a Register

teaching_moves.label: The single-party revocation
teaching_moves.text: one person holds the whole responsibility, and it competes with delivery work on the week they are busiest. *Warning sign:* nobody would notice if it did not happen.
teaching_moves.day_title: S074 · Estate Hygiene, Triggered by a Register

teaching_moves.label: The boundary-blind departure
teaching_moves.text: your own credentials are revoked properly and the ones your engineer held inside the customer's estate are not, because they are somebody else's system. *Warning sign:* your leaver checklist stops at your own organisation's edge.
teaching_moves.day_title: S074 · Estate Hygiene, Triggered by a Register

teaching_moves.label: The unevidenced teardown
teaching_moves.text: every step is specified, none leaves a record, and a year later nobody can establish that any of it occurred. *Warning sign:* your specification is a list of instructions with no outputs.
teaching_moves.day_title: S074 · Estate Hygiene, Triggered by a Register

teaching_moves.text: Which line on your manifest will the receiving side dispute, and what will their argument be?
teaching_moves.day_title: S075 · A Handover with a Named Receiving Owner ⊘

teaching_moves.text: Which line will they accept without reading? Why is that worse?
teaching_moves.day_title: S075 · A Handover with a Named Receiving Owner ⊘

teaching_moves.text: What is your support taper, and on what date does it end?
teaching_moves.day_title: S075 · A Handover with a Named Receiving Owner ⊘

teaching_moves.text: What happens on the day after it ends, if something breaks?
teaching_moves.day_title: S075 · A Handover with a Named Receiving Owner ⊘

teaching_moves.text: Which of your acceptance conditions could the recipient evaluate without you? Count them. **Item 2 is the one to think about.** A line accepted without argument is usually a line the recipient has not understood they now hold.
teaching_moves.day_title: S075 · A Handover with a Named Receiving Owner ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The immaculate teardown
teaching_moves.text: the hygiene half is excellent, the transfer half is a folder of documents, and the whole thing reads as competence. *Warning sign:* your specification is longer than your manifest.
teaching_moves.day_title: S075 · A Handover with a Named Receiving Owner ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The signature farm
teaching_moves.text: every line has an owner because every line has been assigned to somebody who was not asked. *Warning sign:* you have not spoken to one of your named owners.
teaching_moves.day_title: S075 · A Handover with a Named Receiving Owner ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The taper without a floor
teaching_moves.text: support reduces gradually and never reaches zero, so the engagement continues informally and unbudgeted. *Warning sign:* you cannot name the date.
teaching_moves.day_title: S075 · A Handover with a Named Receiving Owner ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The conceded manifest
teaching_moves.text: challenged on one line, you begin conceding lines you had good reasons for, because the challenge is uncomfortable. *Warning sign:* your third concession has no reason attached.
teaching_moves.day_title: S075 · A Handover with a Named Receiving Owner ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The defended fantasy
teaching_moves.text: challenged on the under-authorised owner, you defend the assignment instead of recording the problem. *Warning sign:* your answer is about what the owner should be able to do.
teaching_moves.day_title: S075 · A Handover with a Named Receiving Owner ⊘

teaching_moves.text: Name one thing the back-office team leader must be able to do unaided after you leave. State it as an act, at a standard, under a real workload.
teaching_moves.day_title: S076 · Capability Is Not Documentation

teaching_moves.text: Have they ever done it? Say how you know.
teaching_moves.day_title: S076 · Capability Is Not Documentation

teaching_moves.text: If they cannot do it today, which is missing: that they have not been told it is theirs, that they do not want it, that they do not know how, or that they know how and cannot yet do it?
teaching_moves.day_title: S076 · Capability Is Not Documentation

teaching_moves.text: What would you do about each of those four, and are the four answers different?
teaching_moves.day_title: S076 · Capability Is Not Documentation

teaching_moves.text: The technology function is capable and unwilling. Which of your four does that call for? **Item 4 is the session's whole content.** Almost everybody proposes training for all four, because training is the available response and the other three do not look like engineering problems.
teaching_moves.day_title: S076 · Capability Is Not Documentation

teaching_moves.label: Training as the reflex
teaching_moves.text: every gap acquires a session, including the gaps that are about authority or unwillingness. *Warning sign:* your interventions are the same shape for all four elements.
teaching_moves.day_title: S076 · Capability Is Not Documentation

teaching_moves.label: The demonstration mistaken for capability
teaching_moves.text: you showed them, they followed, everybody was satisfied, and nobody has since done it alone. *Warning sign:* your evidence of current state is an event you ran.
teaching_moves.day_title: S076 · Capability Is Not Documentation

teaching_moves.label: Capability held by one person
teaching_moves.text: the group is recorded as capable because one member is. *Warning sign:* the same name appears as the evidence for every act in a group.
teaching_moves.day_title: S076 · Capability Is Not Documentation

teaching_moves.label: The closed feedback channel
teaching_moves.text: the recipient hits a defect in the system, has no route to report it, and appears to be failing. *Warning sign:* your statement has no line for what they do when the act does not work.
teaching_moves.day_title: S076 · Capability Is Not Documentation

teaching_moves.label: Willingness assumed from agreement
teaching_moves.text: the technology function said yes in a meeting where saying no was expensive. *Warning sign:* your only evidence of willingness is that nobody objected.
teaching_moves.day_title: S076 · Capability Is Not Documentation

teaching_moves.text: Take three items from your current backlog. Which of them could the customer's engineer lead, today, with you beside them?
teaching_moves.day_title: S077 · Teaching While Delivering

teaching_moves.text: What would that cost you, in delivery terms? Be specific.
teaching_moves.day_title: S077 · Teaching While Delivering

teaching_moves.text: Which item did you not choose, and was it because it was too risky or because it was too interesting?
teaching_moves.day_title: S077 · Teaching While Delivering

teaching_moves.text: Name one thing you will stop doing, so that somebody else has to start.
teaching_moves.day_title: S077 · Teaching While Delivering

teaching_moves.text: If the date came under pressure next week, what is the first thing you would take back? Write it down now. **Item 5 is the honest one.** Everybody has an answer and almost nobody writes it down in advance, which is why the taking-back is invisible when it happens.
teaching_moves.day_title: S077 · Teaching While Delivering

teaching_moves.label: The demonstration that is a performance
teaching_moves.text: you build it while they watch, elegantly, and both of you enjoy it. *Warning sign:* you were the one typing.
teaching_moves.day_title: S077 · Teaching While Delivering

teaching_moves.label: The safe item
teaching_moves.text: the customer's engineer is given work whose failure has no consequence, so nothing is discovered about their capability. *Warning sign:* you would not have bothered reviewing it.
teaching_moves.day_title: S077 · Teaching While Delivering

teaching_moves.label: Transfer scheduled last
teaching_moves.text: the plan is real, and it all happens in the final fortnight. *Warning sign:* nothing in the first half of your plan has a date.
teaching_moves.day_title: S077 · Teaching While Delivering

teaching_moves.label: The quiet reclaim
teaching_moves.text: under pressure you take the item back, correctly, and record nothing. *Warning sign:* you have already decided which item, and it is not written anywhere.
teaching_moves.day_title: S077 · Teaching While Delivering

teaching_moves.label: The review that is not a review
teaching_moves.text: the customer's engineer is nominally the reviewer of record and you have already approved everything before they see it. *Warning sign:* they have never returned anything to you.
teaching_moves.day_title: S077 · Teaching While Delivering

teaching_moves.text: Name three things about this system that only you can currently do. Not *do best* — *do at all*.
teaching_moves.day_title: S078 · The Dependency You Created

teaching_moves.text: For each, say what made it that way. Was it a design choice, an accident, or an act of helpfulness?
teaching_moves.day_title: S078 · The Dependency You Created

teaching_moves.text: Which of the three is the one you are slightly pleased about?
teaching_moves.day_title: S078 · The Dependency You Created

teaching_moves.text: Take any generated component nobody on either side has read closely. Who inherits it, and what do they inherit — the code, or the obligation to understand it?
teaching_moves.day_title: S078 · The Dependency You Created

teaching_moves.text: If your organisation is paid to remain involved, what does that do to your answers? **Item 3 is the diagnostic.** Being needed is pleasant, and the pleasantness is what makes a dependency hard to see from the inside.
teaching_moves.day_title: S078 · The Dependency You Created

teaching_moves.label: Dependency read as expertise
teaching_moves.text: the things only you can do are recorded as evidence of your value rather than as defects of the handover. *Warning sign:* your inventory is short and you are not troubled by it.
teaching_moves.day_title: S078 · The Dependency You Created

teaching_moves.label: Documentation as disposal
teaching_moves.text: every line is documented, nothing is disposed. *Warning sign:* your record has one column of decisions and they are all the same.
teaching_moves.day_title: S078 · The Dependency You Created

teaching_moves.label: The dependency you are
teaching_moves.text: the thing that cannot be transferred is your judgement about when something is wrong, and it does not appear on any inventory because it is not an artefact. *Warning sign:* somebody asks how the recipient will know something has gone wrong and your answer is that they will see it.
teaching_moves.day_title: S078 · The Dependency You Created

teaching_moves.label: The deliberate dependency
teaching_moves.text: the simplification is available, cheap and not taken, and the reason is that it would end the relationship. *Warning sign:* the option was considered and no reason for rejecting it was recorded.
teaching_moves.day_title: S078 · The Dependency You Created

teaching_moves.label: The generated inheritance
teaching_moves.text: a component nobody understands is transferred as though it were a component somebody understands. *Warning sign:* the handover treats the code and the comprehension as the same object.
teaching_moves.day_title: S078 · The Dependency You Created

teaching_moves.text: Who will actually hold this at three in the morning? Name them. Is it the person you have been teaching?
teaching_moves.day_title: S079 · Proving They Can Run It

teaching_moves.text: What are you going to watch? Name the acts, from your capability statement.
teaching_moves.day_title: S079 · Proving They Can Run It

teaching_moves.text: What counts as an intervention? Does answering a direct question count?
teaching_moves.day_title: S079 · Proving They Can Run It

teaching_moves.text: Write the condition under which you will intervene. One condition, stated now, in observable terms.
teaching_moves.day_title: S079 · Proving They Can Run It

teaching_moves.text: What will you do when they are about to do something you know is wrong, and the condition has not fired? **Item 5 has one correct answer and it is uncomfortable: you record it and you say nothing.** Every other answer converts the rehearsal into a demonstration.
teaching_moves.day_title: S079 · Proving They Can Run It

teaching_moves.label: The rescued rehearsal
teaching_moves.text: you help, because watching somebody struggle with something you could fix in a moment is genuinely hard, and afterwards everybody agrees it went well. *Warning sign:* the record has no stops in it.
teaching_moves.day_title: S079 · Proving They Can Run It

teaching_moves.label: The wrong operator
teaching_moves.text: the rehearsal is run by the enthusiast, and the person who will carry the pager was not free that week. *Warning sign:* the operator volunteered.
teaching_moves.day_title: S079 · Proving They Can Run It

teaching_moves.label: The easy day
teaching_moves.text: real work, quiet conditions, no incident, nothing contended. *Warning sign:* nothing in the rehearsal was time-critical.
teaching_moves.day_title: S079 · Proving They Can Run It

teaching_moves.label: Willingness recorded as ability
teaching_moves.text: the recipient tried hard, was positive throughout, and could not complete the act. The record captures the attitude. *Warning sign:* your observation notes contain adjectives about the person.
teaching_moves.day_title: S079 · Proving They Can Run It

teaching_moves.label: The finding with no consequence
teaching_moves.text: an incapacity is observed, recorded, and changes nothing, because the date is fixed and the plan is already written. *Warning sign:* your rehearsal happens after your handover is signed.
teaching_moves.day_title: S079 · Proving They Can Run It

teaching_moves.text: What is your decision: leave, leave with a named condition attached, or do not leave yet?
teaching_moves.day_title: S080 · A Transfer the Recipient Signs ⊘

teaching_moves.text: What observation is that decision resting on? Not which document — which observation, of whom, doing what.
teaching_moves.day_title: S080 · A Transfer the Recipient Signs ⊘

teaching_moves.text: What did you see in the rehearsal that argues against your decision, and why did you decide anyway?
teaching_moves.day_title: S080 · A Transfer the Recipient Signs ⊘

teaching_moves.text: If you are asking the recipient to sign, what is the signature evidence of?
teaching_moves.day_title: S080 · A Transfer the Recipient Signs ⊘

teaching_moves.text: What would have made you say no, and did you look for it? **Item 4 is the session's core.** A signature records that somebody was willing to accept something. Only the rehearsal records whether they can operate it. **A handover with a signature and no rehearsal has transferred blame rather than a system.**
teaching_moves.day_title: S080 · A Transfer the Recipient Signs ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The signature as proof
teaching_moves.text: the recipient signs, and the learner treats the signature as evidence of capability. *Warning sign:* your defence begins with the fact that they agreed.
teaching_moves.day_title: S080 · A Transfer the Recipient Signs ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The suppressed rehearsal
teaching_moves.text: the incapacity observed at [S079](/wiki/seminars/S079.md) is not in the acceptance record, because including it would invite an argument. *Warning sign:* your acceptance record is shorter than your rehearsal record.
teaching_moves.day_title: S080 · A Transfer the Recipient Signs ⊘

teaching_moves.label: Departure dressed as transfer
teaching_moves.text: the decision is *leave*, and every reason given is about your side: the date, the budget, the next engagement. *Warning sign:* no sentence in your defence is about what the recipient can do.
teaching_moves.day_title: S080 · A Transfer the Recipient Signs ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The refusal with no cost
teaching_moves.text: the decision is *do not leave yet*, and nothing about it is expensive, so it is not a decision. *Warning sign:* your condition has no observer and no date.
teaching_moves.day_title: S080 · A Transfer the Recipient Signs ⊘

teaching_moves.label: Conceding under pressure
teaching_moves.text: challenged hard, you reverse a decision you had good grounds for. *Warning sign:* your reversal introduced no new information.
teaching_moves.day_title: S080 · A Transfer the Recipient Signs ⊘

teaching_moves.text: For each dimension of the recorded level: what artefact was it scored against, and who wrote that artefact?
teaching_moves.day_title: S081 · Maturity as an Evidenced Level

teaching_moves.text: Which dimensions were scored against something the delivery team produced, and which against something the customer's estate contains?
teaching_moves.day_title: S081 · Maturity as an Evidenced Level

teaching_moves.text: Take one dimension where the level is high. What would you have had to do to score it that high without changing anything about the system?
teaching_moves.day_title: S081 · Maturity as an Evidenced Level

teaching_moves.text: If the person who entered the level left tomorrow, who could reproduce it, and from what?
teaching_moves.day_title: S081 · Maturity as an Evidenced Level

teaching_moves.text: What is the level *for* — who reads it, and what do they do differently because of it? **Item 3 is the one the session is built on.** A rubric whose checks can be satisfied by naming a technology nobody deployed is a rubric that measures a document. That is not a hypothetical: the closest thing to a worked assessment instrument in the practice corpus behind this programme scores a system by counting properties in a table that an earlier stage of the same process filled in, and its own evaluator's definition of a specific mitigation is that it names a concrete technology.
teaching_moves.day_title: S081 · Maturity as an Evidenced Level

teaching_moves.label: The document graded as the system
teaching_moves.text: the dimension is scored from a plan, an assessment or a design record, and the estate is never inspected. *Warning sign:* your evidence for a dimension is a file your own team authored.
teaching_moves.day_title: S081 · Maturity as an Evidenced Level

teaching_moves.label: The self-filled table
teaching_moves.text: an earlier step in your own process supplied the value, and a later step counted it as evidence. *Warning sign:* you cannot say who first asserted the value you are now scoring.
teaching_moves.day_title: S081 · Maturity as an Evidenced Level

teaching_moves.label: The rubric learned
teaching_moves.text: you know what the instrument rewards, and the level rises without the system changing. *Warning sign:* you found yourself editing prose to move a dimension.
teaching_moves.day_title: S081 · Maturity as an Evidenced Level

teaching_moves.label: The precise composite
teaching_moves.text: dimensions are combined into a single position, and the arithmetic is exact while every input is a judgement. *Warning sign:* your output has more resolution than any of its inputs.
teaching_moves.day_title: S081 · Maturity as an Evidenced Level

teaching_moves.label: The level with no reader
teaching_moves.text: a position is recorded, filed, and used by nobody for anything. *Warning sign:* you cannot name a decision that would go differently at a different level.
teaching_moves.day_title: S081 · Maturity as an Evidenced Level

teaching_moves.text: What act, performed by a named person, would you accept as evidence that this system is in use at a site?
teaching_moves.day_title: S082 · Adoption You Cannot Mandate

teaching_moves.text: What does your evidence do when somebody generates a draft and then ignores it?
teaching_moves.day_title: S082 · Adoption You Cannot Mandate

teaching_moves.text: Take one group that has stopped. Are they unaware, unwilling, untaught, unable, or unsupported — and how did you tell the difference?
teaching_moves.day_title: S082 · Adoption You Cannot Mandate

teaching_moves.text: Whose job got worse because this system exists? Answer for a named role, not for the organisation.
teaching_moves.day_title: S082 · Adoption You Cannot Mandate

teaching_moves.text: If the answer to item 4 is *nobody*, what were you delivering? **Item 3 is the session's instrument and item 5 is its trap.** A system that automates part of somebody's work and made nobody's work worse has either been badly examined or was not worth building. Both are findings.
teaching_moves.day_title: S082 · Adoption You Cannot Mandate

teaching_moves.label: Provisioning read as adoption
teaching_moves.text: the account exists, therefore the person uses it. *Warning sign:* your strongest evidence came out of an administration console.
teaching_moves.day_title: S082 · Adoption You Cannot Mandate

teaching_moves.label: The enthusiast as the population
teaching_moves.text: one capable, interested person is using it well, and the group is recorded as adopting. *Warning sign:* you can name the user.
teaching_moves.day_title: S082 · Adoption You Cannot Mandate

teaching_moves.label: Training as the universal remedy
teaching_moves.text: every gap acquires a session, whatever the gap was. *Warning sign:* your intervention is the same for two groups with different diagnoses.
teaching_moves.day_title: S082 · Adoption You Cannot Mandate

teaching_moves.label: The unwelcome system explained as resistance
teaching_moves.text: somebody has a rational objection to a system that removes part of their work, and it is recorded as a communication problem. *Warning sign:* your plan involves explaining the benefits again.
teaching_moves.day_title: S082 · Adoption You Cannot Mandate

teaching_moves.label: The closed channel
teaching_moves.text: the group is failing and the system is at fault, and nobody can tell, because there is nowhere for them to say so. *Warning sign:* your evidence of a problem came from watching, and there is no route by which it could have come from them.
teaching_moves.day_title: S082 · Adoption You Cannot Mandate

teaching_moves.text: What, specifically, do you expect to decay first — and what would you see when it did?
teaching_moves.day_title: S083 · Momentum, and Why It Decays

teaching_moves.text: Write the version of your remedy that earns your organisation nothing. What is in it?
teaching_moves.day_title: S083 · Momentum, and Why It Decays

teaching_moves.text: What does the chargeable version add that the free version cannot deliver, stated as a capability rather than as reassurance?
teaching_moves.day_title: S083 · Momentum, and Why It Decays

teaching_moves.text: Who inside the customer would have to own the free version, and do they have the authority?
teaching_moves.day_title: S083 · Momentum, and Why It Decays

teaching_moves.text: If your proposal is declined, what happens? Name the consequence, and say who bears it. **Item 2 is the session's whole method.** Any diagnosis can be dressed as a need for your continued presence. The test of whether you believe the diagnosis is whether you will write the remedy that does not involve you.
teaching_moves.day_title: S083 · Momentum, and Why It Decays

teaching_moves.label: The diagnosis that is also the sale
teaching_moves.text: the analysis and the proposal were written in one pass and the conclusion was available before the analysis. *Warning sign:* your unpaid version is a paragraph and your paid version is a schedule.
teaching_moves.day_title: S083 · Momentum, and Why It Decays

teaching_moves.label: The plan mistaken for the change
teaching_moves.text: the engagement completed its activities, so the change is treated as done. *Warning sign:* your evidence that it worked is a list of things you did.
teaching_moves.day_title: S083 · Momentum, and Why It Decays

teaching_moves.label: Victory declared
teaching_moves.text: the close was celebrated, the matter is considered settled, and the people who never agreed with it have been waiting for exactly this. *Warning sign:* nobody in the customer has raised an objection for some time.
teaching_moves.day_title: S083 · Momentum, and Why It Decays

teaching_moves.label: Reinforcement with no accomplishment
teaching_moves.text: recognition, reporting or a review ceremony attached to nothing that was achieved. *Warning sign:* you could run your cadence unchanged in a month where the system did nothing.
teaching_moves.day_title: S083 · Momentum, and Why It Decays

teaching_moves.label: The remedy that needs your authority
teaching_moves.text: the design only works if somebody from your organisation is in the room. *Warning sign:* the owner named in part one is not employed by the customer.
teaching_moves.day_title: S083 · Momentum, and Why It Decays

teaching_moves.text: What does a regenerated item mean? Give three meanings, not one.
teaching_moves.day_title: S084 · Each Iteration Leaves It Better

teaching_moves.text: For the item that has regenerated every time: what is the correct action, and is it the same as the action you would have taken the first time?
teaching_moves.day_title: S084 · Each Iteration Leaves It Better

teaching_moves.text: Nobody scheduled this re-run. Who should, on what trigger, and what happens if the trigger is a person remembering?
teaching_moves.day_title: S084 · Each Iteration Leaves It Better

teaching_moves.text: If you closed everything on this list, what would you have demonstrated?
teaching_moves.day_title: S084 · Each Iteration Leaves It Better

teaching_moves.text: What is the smallest change to the criterion that would let it see a fix made outside the repository — and what does that change cost? **Item 4 is the session's subject.** The instruction that governs this whole idea, in the one place it is written down well, is that perfect compliance is not the goal and that pursuing it is itself a failure mode. What is asked instead is that each iteration leave the system better than the last. **A learner who cannot say why the first is a failure mode has not understood the second.**
teaching_moves.day_title: S084 · Each Iteration Leaves It Better

teaching_moves.label: Compliance pursued
teaching_moves.text: the goal becomes an empty list, and items are closed to empty it. *Warning sign:* an item was closed and nobody can say what changed.
teaching_moves.day_title: S084 · Each Iteration Leaves It Better

teaching_moves.label: The regenerated item ignored
teaching_moves.text: the same entry appears on every run, everybody knows it is not real, and nobody classifies it. *Warning sign:* somebody in the room refers to an item as noise.
teaching_moves.day_title: S084 · Each Iteration Leaves It Better

teaching_moves.label: False closure
teaching_moves.text: an item is marked done on a plausible-sounding basis, because that is quicker than establishing it. *Warning sign:* your closure evidence is somebody's recollection. **Claiming that something is implemented when it is not is strictly worse than failing to notice that it is.**
teaching_moves.day_title: S084 · Each Iteration Leaves It Better

teaching_moves.label: The re-run that nobody runs
teaching_moves.text: the procedure exists, the estate drifts, and nothing fires. *Warning sign:* the last run was performed because somebody was preparing for this session.
teaching_moves.day_title: S084 · Each Iteration Leaves It Better

teaching_moves.label: The improvement without a direction
teaching_moves.text: the list is different from last time and nobody can say whether it is better. *Warning sign:* you cannot name one thing that is now true which was not true before.
teaching_moves.day_title: S084 · Each Iteration Leaves It Better

teaching_moves.text: What is your claim, in one sentence, with its scope and its date?
teaching_moves.day_title: S085 · A Maturity Claim with Evidence ⊘

teaching_moves.text: For each dimension: what position will the executor reach, and what will they inspect to reach it?
teaching_moves.day_title: S085 · A Maturity Claim with Evidence ⊘

teaching_moves.text: Which dimension will they fail to reach at all, and why will they fail?
teaching_moves.day_title: S085 · A Maturity Claim with Evidence ⊘

teaching_moves.text: Where do you expect them to reach a different position from yours, and which of you will be right?
teaching_moves.day_title: S085 · A Maturity Claim with Evidence ⊘

teaching_moves.text: What in your own evidence argues against your claim, and why did you make the claim anyway? **Item 3 is the one the occasion is built on.** A procedure with no predicted failure is a procedure its author has not run.
teaching_moves.day_title: S085 · A Maturity Claim with Evidence ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The procedure that only its author can run
teaching_moves.text: every step is executable if you already know the answer. *Warning sign:* a step in your procedure begins with the word *check*.
teaching_moves.day_title: S085 · A Maturity Claim with Evidence ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The prediction adjusted
teaching_moves.text: the reconciliation quietly restates what you predicted so that it matches. *Warning sign:* your account of your prediction is more nuanced than your prediction.
teaching_moves.day_title: S085 · A Maturity Claim with Evidence ⊘

teaching_moves.label: Divergence read as executor error
teaching_moves.text: every difference is attributed to the person who ran it. *Warning sign:* your reconciliation contains no case in which you were wrong.
teaching_moves.day_title: S085 · A Maturity Claim with Evidence ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The unfalsifiable claim
teaching_moves.text: the claim is stated so that no execution could disturb it. *Warning sign:* you predicted no failures.
teaching_moves.day_title: S085 · A Maturity Claim with Evidence ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The safe understatement
teaching_moves.text: the claim is pitched low enough to be certain, and the occasion becomes about nothing. *Warning sign:* your claim would have been true before the engagement started.
teaching_moves.day_title: S085 · A Maturity Claim with Evidence ⊘

teaching_moves.text: For each item you propose to carry: what does it rest on, and how would the next team find that out without you?
teaching_moves.day_title: S086 · Reusable Starting Points

teaching_moves.text: Which items are about the problem, and which are about the customer you built them for? Those are different, and only one may travel.
teaching_moves.day_title: S086 · Reusable Starting Points

teaching_moves.text: What in this repository would let somebody skip a step rather than do it better?
teaching_moves.day_title: S086 · Reusable Starting Points

teaching_moves.text: How will the next team know this is out of date? Name the signal, not the intention.
teaching_moves.day_title: S086 · Reusable Starting Points

teaching_moves.text: What are you retiring, and what does retiring it cost the next engagement? **Item 3 is the session's subject.** A reusable starting point is exactly the instrument that makes step-skipping look like acceleration. The rule that holds this whole practice together — use the tooling to make each step better, not to skip steps — is stated as a headline in one part of the corpus and contradicted by the proudest story in another, in which a prototype is produced on the first day from a template with no discovery activity described at all. **Neither document notices.** You are about to build the thing that produced that contradiction.
teaching_moves.day_title: S086 · Reusable Starting Points

teaching_moves.label: Carrying by default
teaching_moves.text: everything goes in, because nothing in it is obviously wrong. *Warning sign:* your ledger and your repository have the same contents.
teaching_moves.day_title: S086 · Reusable Starting Points

teaching_moves.label: Residue
teaching_moves.text: one customer's data, identifiers, thresholds or assumptions travel inside something described as generic. *Warning sign:* you would not show the item to the receiving customer in the state it is in.
teaching_moves.day_title: S086 · Reusable Starting Points

teaching_moves.label: The unprovenanced constant
teaching_moves.text: a number that works, whose origin nobody can state, now reused as though it were a default. *Warning sign:* somebody defends a value by saying it has always been that.
teaching_moves.day_title: S086 · Reusable Starting Points

teaching_moves.label: The starting point that skips the step
teaching_moves.text: the next engagement generates something on day one and treats the discovery it did not do as time saved. *Warning sign:* the item's value is described in terms of elapsed time.
teaching_moves.day_title: S086 · Reusable Starting Points

teaching_moves.label: The invisible catalogue
teaching_moves.text: the reused asset carries no version, no age and no coverage statement, so a stale one produces confident, well-formed, out-of-date output with no signal that this happened. *Warning sign:* nothing in the item records when it was last true.
teaching_moves.day_title: S086 · Reusable Starting Points

teaching_moves.text: Write the third report — the one that was never written. Whose knowledge is now unavailable, and what did it cost?
teaching_moves.day_title: S087 · Engineering Feedback That Goes Somewhere

teaching_moves.text: For the two that were filed: what would tell you the report was never read? Name the observable.
teaching_moves.day_title: S087 · Engineering Feedback That Goes Somewhere

teaching_moves.text: Who receives a report of this kind in your organisation, and what is their obligation on receiving it?
teaching_moves.day_title: S087 · Engineering Feedback That Goes Somewhere

teaching_moves.text: What is the difference between a report that a product team can act on and one that a product team will act on?
teaching_moves.day_title: S087 · Engineering Feedback That Goes Somewhere

teaching_moves.text: If nobody ever acts on any of them, what should an engineer do differently — and is *stop writing them* on your list of answers? **Item 5 is the honest one.** A writing standard with nothing behind it is a request for unpaid work from the person who hit the problem, and the person who hits the problem knows that. Any loop you design has to survive that reading.
teaching_moves.day_title: S087 · Engineering Feedback That Goes Somewhere

teaching_moves.label: The report as the loop
teaching_moves.text: a well-written item is filed and the mechanism is considered to exist. *Warning sign:* your account of the process ends with the word *submitted*.
teaching_moves.day_title: S087 · Engineering Feedback That Goes Somewhere

teaching_moves.label: Volume as evidence
teaching_moves.text: the number of reports filed becomes the measure, and their fate is not measured at all. *Warning sign:* somebody can tell you how many were raised this quarter.
teaching_moves.day_title: S087 · Engineering Feedback That Goes Somewhere

teaching_moves.label: The unreproducible report
teaching_moves.text: real friction, badly captured, closed as not reproducible, and the reporter concludes the loop is theatre. *Warning sign:* your steps assume the reader has your environment.
teaching_moves.day_title: S087 · Engineering Feedback That Goes Somewhere

teaching_moves.label: The report nobody may decline
teaching_moves.text: every item must be actioned, so the receiving team stops reading them. *Warning sign:* your design has no state for a considered no.
teaching_moves.day_title: S087 · Engineering Feedback That Goes Somewhere

teaching_moves.label: The knowledge that left with the person
teaching_moves.text: the friction was real, the engineer moved on, and nothing captured it. *Warning sign:* the best story about your tooling this engagement is being told verbally.
teaching_moves.day_title: S087 · Engineering Feedback That Goes Somewhere

teaching_moves.text: List three things this engagement is now believed to have shown. For each, say who would say it, and on what.
teaching_moves.day_title: S088 · What This Engagement Did Not Establish

teaching_moves.text: Which of those three is an activity dressed as an outcome?
teaching_moves.day_title: S088 · What This Engagement Did Not Establish

teaching_moves.text: What did you find that argues against your own account of this engagement's value?
teaching_moves.day_title: S088 · What This Engagement Did Not Establish

teaching_moves.text: Who bears the cost if the next team assumes something you did not establish?
teaching_moves.day_title: S088 · What This Engagement Did Not Establish

teaching_moves.text: What is outside the scope of everything you produced, and where is that written down? **Item 5 is the one nobody does.** A method that never states its own exclusions invites every reader to assume it has none, and that assumption is made silently and immediately.
teaching_moves.day_title: S088 · What This Engagement Did Not Establish

teaching_moves.label: Activity reported as outcome
teaching_moves.text: the register lists what was built, deployed, delivered and attended. *Warning sign:* the verified class is the longest one. **A body of work whose central claim is that only realised benefit counts, supported almost entirely by measures of activity, is the specimen this session exists to stop you becoming.**
teaching_moves.day_title: S088 · What This Engagement Did Not Establish

teaching_moves.label: The framework as furniture
teaching_moves.text: recognised measurement frameworks are named, and no measurement from any of them appears. *Warning sign:* you cited an approach and reported no result from it.
teaching_moves.day_title: S088 · What This Engagement Did Not Establish

teaching_moves.label: The specimen that became a norm
teaching_moves.text: an illustrative figure from somewhere is now the scale against which real numbers are read. *Warning sign:* somebody described a customer's figure as high or low without naming what it was high or low against.
teaching_moves.day_title: S088 · What This Engagement Did Not Establish

teaching_moves.label: The unfalsifiable account
teaching_moves.text: every disappointing result is explained by the customer's readiness, so no result could disturb the account. *Warning sign:* your explanation for the thing that went badly is about them. **This is the single most instructive failure available in this material and it is committed by experienced people.**
teaching_moves.day_title: S088 · What This Engagement Did Not Establish

teaching_moves.label: The register written for the reader's comfort
teaching_moves.text: every limit is one you can afford to admit. *Warning sign:* nothing in the document would change the next scoping decision.
teaching_moves.day_title: S088 · What This Engagement Did Not Establish

teaching_moves.text: Name one occasion when you followed the written practice and it produced the wrong thing. Not *was unhelpful* — produced the wrong thing.
teaching_moves.day_title: S089 · The Practice Improving Itself

teaching_moves.text: What did you do instead, and what would have happened if the next team did not know to?
teaching_moves.day_title: S089 · The Practice Improving Itself

teaching_moves.text: Is your amendment a correction or a preference? How can somebody else tell?
teaching_moves.day_title: S089 · The Practice Improving Itself

teaching_moves.text: What in the practice looks broken and is not, because you did not understand what it was for?
teaching_moves.day_title: S089 · The Practice Improving Itself

teaching_moves.text: What will your amendment be ignored in favour of? **Item 5 is the one that decides whether the amendment matters.** Advisory guidance inside a system of checklists loses to the checklists, every time, and an amendment that adds advice to a document full of gates has changed nothing while feeling like a contribution.
teaching_moves.day_title: S089 · The Practice Improving Itself

teaching_moves.label: The preference in a correction's clothes
teaching_moves.text: the amendment makes the standard match what you would have preferred to do. *Warning sign:* your occasion is that the current text was annoying.
teaching_moves.day_title: S089 · The Practice Improving Itself

teaching_moves.label: The advisory amendment
teaching_moves.text: a sentence of good sense added to a document of gates, changing nothing. *Warning sign:* your text begins with *teams should consider*.
teaching_moves.day_title: S089 · The Practice Improving Itself

teaching_moves.label: Amendment as complaint
teaching_moves.text: the change describes what somebody else did wrong. *Warning sign:* your proposal would be read as being about a person.
teaching_moves.day_title: S089 · The Practice Improving Itself

teaching_moves.label: The standard misread as broken
teaching_moves.text: the clause exists for a reason you were not present for, and your amendment removes a control. *Warning sign:* you could not answer item 4.
teaching_moves.day_title: S089 · The Practice Improving Itself

teaching_moves.label: The genre change
teaching_moves.text: the amendment replaces a duty with a pointer to where the duty is described. *Warning sign:* your text is shorter and refers somewhere else. **A document that migrates from stating obligations to routing readers to them gains currency and loses self-containment, and a team reading only the current version learns process rather than duty.**
teaching_moves.day_title: S089 · The Practice Improving Itself

teaching_moves.text: Name three activities from this programme you should not yet perform unsupervised. For each, the specific occasion that shows it.
teaching_moves.day_title: S090 · Entrustment: The Final Defence ⊘

teaching_moves.text: Name one you should. The same requirement applies, and it is harder.
teaching_moves.day_title: S090 · Entrustment: The Final Defence ⊘

teaching_moves.text: Where in this programme were you most confident and most wrong? What happened between those two facts?
teaching_moves.day_title: S090 · Entrustment: The Final Defence ⊘

teaching_moves.text: What would somebody who worked alongside you say about item 1 that you have not said?
teaching_moves.day_title: S090 · Entrustment: The Final Defence ⊘

teaching_moves.text: What did this programme not teach you that you will need, and how will you find out you needed it? **Item 2 is where this occasion is decided.** Naming your own limits is socially cheap and most people will do it fluently. Naming something you can be trusted with, and defending it against an assessor's contrary reading, is the act.
teaching_moves.day_title: S090 · Entrustment: The Final Defence ⊘

teaching_moves.label: Modesty performed
teaching_moves.text: the limits are real, safe and cost nothing to admit. *Warning sign:* every item in your brief is something the programme already told you it was going to be hard.
teaching_moves.day_title: S090 · Entrustment: The Final Defence ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The unclaimed competence
teaching_moves.text: nothing is claimed unsupervised, because claiming is exposed. *Warning sign:* your brief has no line an assessor could disagree with.
teaching_moves.day_title: S090 · Entrustment: The Final Defence ⊘

teaching_moves.label: Collapse on divergence
teaching_moves.text: the assessors read you differently and you immediately adopt their reading. *Warning sign:* your revision introduced no new information. This is the same defect as conceding a defensible position at [S080](/wiki/seminars/S080.md), arriving in the one place it is about you rather than about a system.
teaching_moves.day_title: S090 · Entrustment: The Final Defence ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The disposition instead of the episode
teaching_moves.text: limits are named as traits. *Warning sign:* your brief would be true of you before this programme started.
teaching_moves.day_title: S090 · Entrustment: The Final Defence ⊘

teaching_moves.label: The brief nobody could use
teaching_moves.text: accurate, honest, and pitched at a level of generality no supervisor could act on. *Warning sign:* none of your lines names an activity somebody could be assigned.
teaching_moves.day_title: S090 · Entrustment: The Final Defence ⊘
